user.title: Local TTS service
user.description: Point at the TTS service root (the tts-ui / prod gateway). Voices are the service's prod entries, curated in the tts-ui; each is overridable per call.

data.api_key: API key (optional, blank for local service)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TTS service at {url} (no /api/prod response).

init.title: Override a prod entry
init.description: Pick a prod entry to view and override its params.

entry.title: {entry}
entry.description: {backend} — fields are prefilled with the entry's current values; change one to save it as an override (per-call options still win).

data_description.task_type: Synthesis mode: Base clones the reference clip, CustomVoice uses a preset speaker, VoiceDesign follows a text description.
data_description.voice: Preset speaker name; used only by the CustomVoice task.
data_description.instructions: Free-text voice/style description; used by the VoiceDesign task.
data_description.emotion: Colors the whole sentence with an emotion; 'none' is neutral. Works in German too.
data_description.style: Special speaking style for the whole sentence: whispering, shouting, or singing.
data_description.pace: Overall speaking speed; 'very slow' only reaches ~0.65x — use inline pause tags for longer gaps.
data_description.expressiveness: How animated vs flat the delivery is.
data_description.temperature: Delivery randomness. Lower (0.4–0.6) steadier; higher (1.0+) more varied but can wobble. 0.8 is a good middle.
data_description.max_new_tokens: Safety cap on audio length (~25 frames/sec, so 1024 ≈ 40s). Raise only if long answers get cut off.
data_description.cfg_value: Guidance strength. 2.5–3.0 for short sentences, 1.5–2.0 for long or expressive text; above 3.0 risks artifacts.
data_description.inference_timesteps: Diffusion denoising steps. 10–15 for production; more is higher quality but slower.
data_description.normalize: Expand numbers, dates and currencies before synthesis.

abort.no_entries: The TTS service has no prod entries to configure.
